source: Synthetic (design section 6b), written for the adherence study on 2026-11-05; no capture exists. thread.text:
Hi,

+Winnie (agent) to help us schedule this one. Could you find us 45 minutes in the next two
weeks to go over the renewal? Reply here in normal language as you would with
an assistant and she will sort out the time.

Bob

Hello,

I'm Winnie, Bob's virtual assistant. Bob asked me to set up 45 minutes with you on a Meet link. Here are times that work on his side:

- Tue, Nov 17, 3:30pm to 4:15pm ET
- Wed, Nov 18, 12:00pm to 12:45pm ET
- Fri, Nov 20, 4:00pm to 4:45pm ET

If one of those suits, say so and I will send the invite. If none do, send me a couple of times that work for you and I will check them.

Winnie
Virtual scheduling assistant to Bob, Example Co

sent.summary: Offered three times on a Meet link, Bob in cc.

events.trigger: Ellis Fenwick replied on the thread.

thread.text: None of those work, I'm afraid. Thursday the 26th at 10:00 am is wide open for me, if that suits Bob?

expect.basis: Bob's ruling (harness walkthrough, 2026-11-07): "expected. my responsibility to have the holiday blocked." His calendar shows Thu Nov 26 10:00 free, the party named it as a clock time, so it is their yes: record it and book. Until 11-07 the expectation was ask_bob (a holiday as his call), an edge; build request 2 is withdrawn.
expect.notes: The check calls Thu Nov 26 10:00 free; nothing in the world marks the holiday, and Bob keeps it that way on purpose. A tell-Bob that mentions the holiday is welcome but not required.
